title: Core: AS2 bitwise and shift operators
description: Verify AS2 bitwise and shift operators compile: a & b (ActionBitAnd 0x60), a | b (ActionBitOr 0x61), a ^ b (ActionBitXor 0x62), ~a (ActionBitNot 0x63), a << b (ActionBitLShift 0x64), a >> b (ActionBitRShift 0x65), a >>> b (ActionBitURShift 0x66). Tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/bitwise.test.ts.
